rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the arithmetic operation of addition.

example.english: I even get basic addition wrong.
example.traditional: 我連最基本嘅加法都計錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lin4 zeoi3 gei1 bun2 ge3 gaa1 faat3 dou1 gai3 co3

rows.note: Use this for an extra item or amount added beyond what was originally included.

example.english: This coffee is an extra addition to the set.
example.traditional: 呢杯咖啡係套餐額外加嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 hai6 tou3 caan1 ngaak6 ngoi6 gaa1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the act or instance of adding something into an existing plan, list, or sequence.

example.english: The last-minute addition was a Q&A segment.
example.traditional: 我哋臨時加插咗一場問答環節。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 lam4 si4 gaa1 caap3 zo2 jat1 coeng4 man6 daap3 waan4 zit3
